firstPlayerRule: The player who is most fastidious about sorting garbage starts the first round.
clarifications: For later rounds, the starting player is the one who got the worst catastrophe in the previous round.
The starter selects the first land tile for auction and makes the opening bid; bidding then proceeds clockwise.

internalEvidence: Original review used indexed text of the CGE PDF; its download returned HTTP 404 on 2026-09-23 and again in the 2026-09-26 availability audit. Codex source repair and exact-revision review, 2026-09-26, under the owner's 2026-09-22 standing authorization: downloaded the English manual directly from Rio Grande Games with normal certificate validation (HTTP 200, application/pdf, 7 PDF pages). Rendered and visually checked PDF pages 2, 3 and 7: printed pages 2-3 give Player Setup; printed pages 4-5 give Phase 1: Setup and Phase 2: Land Auction; printed page 12 credits Czech Games Edition, October 2010, Vladimir Suchy and translator Jason Holt. The existing public answer and both clarifications match those instructions. No starting-player tie-break is specified. This copy uses two-page spreads, so corrected one-based PDF references to 2 and 3 while retaining printed references 2, 4 and 5.
